result.note: Only the headline is available, so one single question tests which grouping's home ministers adopted the Delhi Declaration on regional security.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, the home ministers of which regional grouping adopted the Delhi Declaration on regional security?
questions.explain: The home ministers of BIMSTEC adopted the Delhi Declaration, which deals with regional security. Its name reflects New Delhi as the setting for the adoption.
questions.source: BIMSTEC home ministers adopt Delhi Declaration on regional security
